gates.gate: SPEC-LIT S32.4 verdict 2 (Reynolds analogy), wall-function leg
gates.against: Gnielinski (1976) evaluated at this leg's own MEASURED wall friction factor, +-10 % band
gates.headline: WF Nu is +34.3% of Gnielinski at the MEASURED f and +15.2% at the viscous form of it - outside the band on both

gates.gate: SPEC-LIT S32.4 verdict 2 (Reynolds analogy), wall-function leg, at PrtModel KaysCrawford (opt-in, S37)
gates.against: Gnielinski (1976) evaluated at this leg's own MEASURED wall friction factor, +-10 % band, on the PrtModel KaysCrawford record
gates.headline: WF Nu is +34.0% of Gnielinski at the MEASURED f, at PrtModel KaysCrawford (opt-in, S37) - outside the band

gates.gate: SPEC-LIT S32.4 verdict 1 (absolute prediction), resolved leg
gates.against: Gnielinski (1976) evaluated at the Petukhov smooth-PIPE f, +-10 % band
gates.headline: resolved leg Nu is +11.9% of it - outside the band by 1.9 points, against an energy-balance uncertainty of 0.00001% which is now round-off, so the gate does NOT close and the miss is DECISIVE with nothing left to hide any of it behind (S32.4's UNDECIDED clause does not apply)

gates.gate: SPEC-LIT S32.4 verdict 2 (Reynolds analogy), resolved leg
gates.against: Gnielinski (1976) evaluated at this leg's own MEASURED wall friction factor, +-10 % band
gates.headline: resolved leg Nu is +14.9% of it at the MEASURED f = 2.3832e-02 - outside the band

gates.gate: SPEC-LIT S60.5 Gate 5
gates.against: Kaminski & Prakash (1986), conjugate natural convection in a square enclosure - through the open-access SECONDARY table of Belazizia et al. (2012), the primary being paywalled and never read - bar 3 % at every conductivity ratio
gates.headline: worst disagreement 98.59 %, and it is at the SMALLEST conductivity ratio - the CONDUCTION-DOMINATED end - shrinking to 11.95 % at Kr = 10; reference-limited at Kr <= 1, SPEC-LIT 115 (O1, D-VAL-4)

gates.gate: SPEC-LIT S88 Gate 88-T
gates.against: the ERCOFTAC T3A flat plate's measured transition, on the NASA/TMBWG 2D T3A rig (U = 69.44 m/s, Re/m = 2.00e5, Tu = 3.300 % at the leading edge)
gates.headline: the model's own onset criterion fires at Re_x = 85251.4, where the local Tu has decayed to 2.24405 % and Re_theta~ = 234.21 - but no published digit-level onset Re_x for T3A was found to hold it against, so the comparison is not closed

gates.gate: SPEC-LIT S90 Gate 90-T
gates.against: the ERCOFTAC T3A flat plate's measured transition, on the NASA/TMBWG 2D T3A rig (U = 69.44 m/s, Re/m = 2.00e5, Tu = 3.300 % at the leading edge)
gates.headline: the 2015 correlation's onset switch fires at Re_x = 22826.1, where the local Tu_L has decayed to 54.6012 % and Re_thetac reads 100 - but no published digit-level onset Re_x for T3A was found to hold it against, so the comparison is not closed

gates.gate: SPEC-LIT S68.12 Gate 68-C
gates.against: Theobald (1981), 90 hose streams, maximum throw, at the shape of the FDS Validation Guide's own metric for this quantity - +-10 % bias, 30 % scatter
gates.headline: with the gas at rest this solver throws the stream 61.2858 % of the measured distance on average

gates.against: Bai & Gosman SAE 950283 (1995) against Mundo, Sommerfeld & Tropea, Int. J. Multiphase Flow 21 (1995) 151
gates.headline: the two published splash criteria disagree by a factor of 4.78 in Weber number for the same 100 um water droplet - Mundo splashes it at 8.99 m/s (We 111), Bai-Gosman at 19.65 m/s (We 531)
